_comment: Every pattern `npdev ai relay ingest` uses. Every regex is Python syntax and is compiled with re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE. npdev_relay_ingest.py reads ONLY this file for patterns: to teach ingest a new desire path, add a pattern here and a case in tests/fixtures/relay/build_cases.py, never a literal in code. Paths use forward slashes after normalisation.

pack._comment: Used ONLY by a conversation whose intent is 'pack' (a browser AI writes a reusable pack, not an app). Code stays out: a pack.json carries capabilities CONTRACTS only, never code. The relay stores pack.json as <packs workspace>/<packId>/pack.json -- the AI never chooses the folder. example-model.json is an OPTIONAL tiny consumer model that imports the pack by local $ref, used to prove the pack composes.

elements._comment: F4/T4.2 (npdev_relay_elements.py reads ONLY this section for what an element upsert may touch). identityKeys = root arrays of model.schema.json whose elements REQUIRE `name` (test_relay_elements pins that against the schema, so a schema change that drops it fails there). wholeFileOnly = root arrays that cannot be sent as upserts, with the reason shown to the AI. A key in neither list is unknown. shrinkWarnRatio: a replaced element whose JSON is smaller than this share of the old one earns an `element-shrank` warning (an AI that thinks an upsert MERGES sends only the changed fields).

wholeFileOnly.conversions: its elements are identified by id, not name
wholeFileOnly.seeds: its elements are identified by id, not name
wholeFileOnly.autoPanels: its elements do not need a name
wholeFileOnly.modules: each context points at a file of its own

markupScan._comment: Which kinds of non-JSON file are scanned for code before they are accepted. A match QUARANTINES the file (reason `<kind>-has-script`): it is code, however it is named. htmlScriptPatterns above is the list for html AND svg (an svg is XML a browser runs scripts in: <script>, onload=, javascript: hrefs); cssScriptPatterns is for css (legacy script hooks). .svg was not scanned before 2026-11-12 -- a script in an svg would have walked past the JS quarantine.

pages._comment: F4/T4.3b (npdev_relay_pages.py reads ONLY this section). Hand-made pages are web/*.html|css|svg beside model.json, mounted into the app's static folder at generation; pages.json ([{path,label,requiredRole?,ordinal?}], path relative to web/) gives a page its menu entry (CompanionPagesMenuEmitter). reservedFiles / reservedDirectories are the names FinalAppAssembler.requireNoReservedWebAssetCollision refuses (twin-pair rule web-asset-reserved-names-two-place): a web/ file with one of them FAILS GENERATION of the whole app, so the relay says so first. externalReferencePatterns find a page that fetches from another site (the app serves no CSP for its own pages): a warning, never a refusal. maxLabelChars bounds a menu label.

menu._comment: menu.json (npdev_relay_pages.py; CompanionPagesMenuEmitter flattens it into workspace-menu-pages-seed.json): a tree of {label, kind?, target?, ordinal?, requiredRole?, children?}. kinds are the ones WORKSPACE-MENU-AND-GUIDEPAGES.md names for a node a person can author; INTERNAL is the seeder's own hidden marker row and is refused. nodeKeys are the keys the emitter reads: any other key is ignored by it, so the relay says so. maxNodes / maxDepth bound a tree no menu needs to exceed.

seeds._comment: F4 (npdev_relay_seeds.py reads ONLY this section). seeds/<id>.json beside model.json is staged by the CLI into the final app's npdev-seed/data-seeds (stage_seeds_into_final_app) and run on demand by SeedDataService. fileKeys / recordKeys / kinds mirror NPDevContract/schemas/seed.schema.json (additionalProperties:false) and generators mirror SeedDataService's switch -- tests/test_relay_seeds.py pins both. maxFileBytes / maxExpandedRecords stop an answer that would write a file or a bulk block no demo needs (a 16 GB laptop runs the app).

elisionPatterns.regex: \((unchanged|same as before|as before|inalterado|inalterada|igual|sem mudan\w*|mesmo que antes)\)

codeScan._comment: REG-354: what a piece of code an AI wrote DOES, said in words before the owner accepts it (never a verdict: a scan cannot prove code safe). Only used when the machine's relay.codeFromBrowserAi setting accepts that kind of code; with the default (never) the code is quarantined and none of this runs. `kinds` is the code kind of each path glob; `scan` is per language.

js.en: reads or writes cookies or the browser's stored data
js.pt: lê ou grava cookies ou dados guardados no navegador

js.en: talks to a server (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket)
js.pt: conversa com um servidor (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket)

js.en: runs text as code (eval, new Function)
js.pt: executa texto como código (eval, new Function)

js.en: loads more code (import(), importScripts, a script tag)
js.pt: carrega mais código (import(), importScripts, uma tag script)

js.en: opens windows or sends the page somewhere else
js.pt: abre janelas ou leva a página para outro lugar

js.en: reads the sign-in key of the app
js.pt: lê a chave de acesso do app

java.en: loads classes by name or uses reflection
java.pt: carrega classes pelo nome ou usa reflexão

java.en: reads the environment or stops the program
java.pt: lê o ambiente ou encerra o programa

promptEcho._comment: Every prompt NPDev composes starts with 'NPDEV-PROMPT <code>-<round>' and ends with 'NPDEV-PROMPT-END <code>-<round>'. Text holding BOTH is the prompt itself (the clipboard still holds it right after COPY), never an answer.
